headline: Bolt Cuts Driver Commissions to 15% in Lagos and Abuja
summary: Ride-hailing platform Bolt has reduced its driver commission fees to 15% in Lagos and Abuja from previous rates of 20% and 21%, aiming to improve driver earnings amid rising operating costs in Nigeria.
why: Platform commission adjustments in major African markets directly affect driver retention, unit economics, and competitive positioning against rivals like Uber.

impacts.name: Bolt
impacts.why: Lowering commissions reduces platform take-rate revenue while potentially boosting driver supply.
